name: squish-hq
description: A friendly business plan builder for children aged 8 to 11, with a grown-up nearby. Runs entirely in the browser.

scripts.package:send: node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.rmSync('private-send',{recursive:true,force:true});fs.mkdirSync('private-send');fs.copyFileSync('index.html','private-send/index.html');fs.cpSync('vendor','private-send/vendor',{recursive:true});console.log('private-send is ready: index.html and vendor/')"
scripts.package:github: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const out='github-upload';fs.rmSync(out,{recursive:true,force:true});const junk=/(^|\/)(thumbs\.db|ehthumbs\.db|desktop\.ini|\.ds_store|\._.*|.*\.tmp|.*\.log)$/i;const walk=d=>fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true}).flatMap(e=>e.isDirectory()?walk(d+'/'+e.name):[d+'/'+e.name]);const files=['.github/workflows/test.yml','.gitattributes','.gitignore','.nojekyll','LICENSE','README.md','index.html','package.json','package-lock.json','assets/og-image.png','tests/squish-hq.test.js','tests/README.md',...walk('vendor').filter(f=>!junk.test(f))];for(const f of files){fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(path.join(out,f)),{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync(f,path.join(out,f));}console.log('github-upload is ready: '+files.length+' files')"
